title: Properties of shape memory polyimide composites with continuous “brick-and-mortar” layered structure: High flame retardancy, ablation resistance, and high mechanical properties
authors: Xiaofei Wang; Yang He; Xinli Xiao; Yanju Liu; Jinsong Leng
source_version: Final published journal article; complete 11-page institutional copy of original PDF
source_document_description: Complete publisher-formatted original main PDF from the authors’ institutional website; whole main text, methods, figures, conclusions and references reviewed; cited supplementary material unavailable
source_material_form_TGA_raw: The prepared SMPIC laminate; section 2.3 explicitly characterizes SMPIC and Figure 2c names each formulation. Aliquot selection is unreported.
TGA_specimen_preparation: A 5–10 mg sample of the corresponding cured SMPIC was measured under N2 at 10.00 mL/min from 25 to 800 °C at 10 °C/min. Pan, aliquot cutting location and conditioning are unreported.
LOI_method: Measured with a ZY6155 oxygen index instrument; oxygen concentration increased from 40% until the sample burned, and the nearest critical concentration was taken as LOI
LOI_statistic: Printed measured value; replication and uncertainty unreported
LOI_specimen_preparation: The corresponding initial cured SMPIC laminate was tested by increasing oxygen concentration until burning. No durability wash, ablation treatment, rapid thermal processing or shape-memory programming is assigned to these initial specimens.
source_numeric_evidence_description: Exact R800 percentages in section 3.1 and printed Figure 2c annotations, with exact LOI labels in Figure 4a; original pixels checked, no digitization
conditions_locator: Sections 2.1–2.3, original PDF page 2; Figure 1 preparation schematic page 3
TG_locator: Section 3.1 and Figure 2c, original PDF page 4
LOI_locator: Section 3.3, PDF page 5; Figure 4a, page 6; own measured oxygen-index method section 2.3, page 2
source_location: Original PDF pages 2–6: preparation and own characterization methods, section 3.1 and Figure 2c R800, section 3.3 and Figure 4a measured LOI; conclusions page 10 and references pages 10–11
source_residue_definition: Section 2.3 uses the residual amount at 800 °C; section 3.1 explicitly lists the state-specific 800 °C residues
source_laminate_thickness_raw: 0.5–1.5 mm after pre-pressing; no individual assay dimensions assigned
source_filler_denominator_raw: Mg(OH)2 and SiO2 mass fractions reported as wt% of whole PAA; not normalized to final laminate mass
source_DTG_metric_hold: Figure 2c inset DTG (mg/°C) has printed colored peak-temperature annotations, but no named maximum-rate metric definition in own methods/prose; canonical Tmax blank
washing_state: Initial cured laminate; no durability laundering or later thermal/shape programming assigned
treatment_method: Equimolar DAPBI and BPDA (1:1) were dissolved in DMSO at 25 °C and mechanically mixed at 200–500 rpm for 120 h under N2 to form polyamic acid (PAA), then divided into two equal parts. One part was mixed with Mg(OH)2 and 5 wt% SiO2, both on the source-reported whole-PAA basis, for 3 h. T300-3K carbon-fiber twill fabric was soaked in the other PAA part at 50 °C for 12 h until DMSO evaporated. The PAA/flame-retardant mixture was poured onto the PAA/CF surface, followed by vacuum-oven solvent removal; that step has no separately reported time or temperature. The layers were stacked and pre-pressed at 180 °C for 10 min and 250 °C for 60 min under 3–5 MPa, producing a general thickness range of 0.5–1.5 mm. Secondary curing used 250 °C for 2 h and 300 °C for 3 h. No durability wash or later thermal/shape programming is assigned to the initial assay state.
limitations: The source-specific R800 values for SMPIC-10, SMPIC-15 and SMPIC-30 agree between section 3.1 and the printed Figure 2c labels; Figure 4a gives exact measured LOI labels. No curve or bar height is digitized. SMPIC-20 and SMPIC-25 are excluded because the prose assigns R800 values 77.3% and 78.8%, respectively, while the blue/green Figure 2c labels assign the reverse. The Figure 2c inset prints DTG peak temperatures but supplies no named operational maximum-rate definition; these are retained only in source-native metadata, with canonical Tmax blank. The 63.6% R800 comparator is explicitly pure SMPI resin cited from the earlier 2022 article; its original Table 2 reports 63.63% for M-SMPI film. It is not paired with the present SMPI/CF laminate LOI of 48.9%. The Mg(OH)2 and SiO2 fractions are reported relative to whole PAA, not as final laminate fractions. Carbon-fabric fraction, ply count, individual specimen thickness, TG pan and aliquot selection, and LOI dimensions, replication, uncertainty and conditioning are unreported. The general laminate thickness is 0.5–1.5 mm. GB2409-84 and UL94-2009 are assigned by the source to vertical combustion and flame grade, not to the LOI test. Supporting information cited for ablation mechanisms, FTIR and actuator demonstrations was not retrievable; the complete original main supplies the retained preparation, TG and measured LOI evidence. No post-ablation, rapid-thermal-processing or shape-programmed state is assigned the initial TG/LOI pair.
sample_state: SMPIC-10; Mg(OH)2/SiO2 polyimide and twill carbon-fabric laminate; initial cured state
composition: Mg(OH)2 10 wt% and SiO2 5 wt%, each on the source-reported whole-PAA basis; alternating filled-polyimide and carbon-fabric/polyimide layers. Carbon-fabric fraction and final filler fractions are unreported.
treatment_chemistry: Mg(OH)2 10 wt% plus SiO2 5 wt% on the source whole-PAA basis
pairing_evidence: Section 2.2 names SMPIC-10 after common laminate preparation and secondary curing. Section 3.1 and Figure 2c give its R800 69.3%; Figure 4a gives its measured LOI 50.5%. Section 2.3 provides own TG and oxygen-index methods for SMPIC. Pure resin, SMPI/CF control and later ablated or thermally programmed states are not substituted.
